prompt: Walk-forward evaluation is producing overlapping windows and an incorrect win-rate aggregate, so rows are scored in more than one window and the summary is wrong. Make the evaluation walk forward over sequential, non-overlapping windows: each window trains on a block of rows and evaluates on the immediately following block, with no row scored twice. Report per-window mean return, max drawdown, and win rate, and aggregate them into a mean window return, a worst-case (maximum) window drawdown, and a mean window win rate. Existing backtest metric names and behavior must not change.
expected_failure_summary: Window step defaults to 1 (overlapping windows) and win rate counts non-negative returns as wins, so window boundaries and aggregates are wrong.
task_author_notes: Default step must equal test_size (non-overlapping). win_rate must count strictly positive returns. Existing net_pnl/compute_metrics must be untouched.
